title: The person who made this app doesn't use it.
body: I'd like to hear a discussion between effective managers and engineers about what a widget should be. Engineers: Let's make it possible to display heartbeat or steps or whatever the user has pinned. Effective manager: No! Let everyone have cycle tracking and Over Night Vitals.
author: Rastagin

title: Not synchronized periodically
body:
Have issues to synchronized with my iPhone continuously and give the update data.
I have trying everything 
They need to restart my iPhone to have the app the last update details 
This is unacceptable
author: SavvasBullcy

title: The worst
body:
I delete metadata from the app but instead the app doubles the space it takes on my iPhone. 
I started from 1.1 gb when I checked in settings and now it is nearly 2gb of memory used by it. After deleting each time it takes more memory. What is this ? Avoid this app. Delete it once you buy your iPhone.
